title: Radio, Channel 1: Cascade at the 15+20 Sump

fields.centerName: Stillwater Creek Interceptor Phase 2 — Site Trailer

lines.text: Super, this is Cascade at the 15+20 sump. The 12-inch pump is running flat out, and the sump level has come up 8 inches since seven o'clock.
I can't keep up with what's coming through that south wall around 16+00. I'm asking for a second pump, but it's a 3-hour delivery. Cascade out.

I've got the Valley Gas drawing and locate ticket 2711-4482 side by side. The drawing shows a service tee at 16+00 heading north to the print shop. There's no paint for it on the ground, only the main mark 4 feet north of the trench edge. E-7 is about 10 feet from 16+00 right now.

fields.voiceStyle: Cascade: man in his 30s, steady but concerned, raising his voice over a running pump. Field engineer: younger woman, quick and a little breathless after walking in from the trench.

instructorNote: This clue inject has two cues: rising water at the south wall and an unmarked gas service tee 10 feet ahead of E-7. Watch whether SUPT or CP stops machine digging near 16+00, has the service exposed by hand or vacuum excavation, and calls Valley Gas and Ohio811 (LETPS 6, steps 3–4). Also watch whether CP re-inspects the south wall because the water level changed (LETPS 2) and records it as a new entry without changing the 06:45 LC-F-22 form.
